notes: ACCESS: roster brand_site spin.co.in returns HTTP 410 Gone (dead domain, verified via curl) - the real live storefront is https://www.madewithspin.com/ (HTTP 200, Shopify store 'Spin - Furniture & Home Decor'), used for all research. robots.txt (www.madewithspin.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific rule and no blanket Disallow: / (only /admin and /cgi-bin), so tier (a) HTTP was permitted throughout; site was never blocked. TREE: tier (a) HTTP-first. Fetched sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (~200 collection URLs) for the raw candidate list, then fetched the homepage HTML (curl) which exposed only a partial static link set. The real mega-menu is rendered by a third-party app (Maker.co / SmartNav / Showside) via a JS widget, so tier (b) Playwright was used to load the homepage and capture the XHR call to https://api.maker.co/api/get_config?config_id=w3uR8lvVC (the live nav-tree JSON, 261 nodes). Parsed that JSON recursively to reconstruct the true current mega-menu hierarchy (Living / Dining / Accessories / Outdoor / Home Office / Bar / Bedroom / Kids top sections), and cross-checked every candidate leaf's canonical URL (all matched the requested slug, no silent-wrong-page cases). Collections present only in the raw XML sitemap but absent from the live get_config nav tree (e.g. /collections/office-storage, /collections/euro-storage, /collections/bar-storage, /collections/bts-storage, /collections/organizers, /collections/office-organisers, /collections/storage-1, /collections/storage-2, /collections/small-storage*, /collections/table-linen accessed directly, /collections/edge-tabel-linen, /collections/bauhaus-table-linen, /collections/storage-pdf) were treated as orphaned/legacy Shopify collections no longer in the live navigation and excluded. QTY: for every included row, qty was cross-verified two ways - the rendered collection page's own 'N products' header text (curl+bs4) AND the Shopify products.json count for the same collection handle (both agreed in every case; used as the evidence). EXCLUDED (checked, not qualifying): 'Drawer Storage' (/collections/drawer-storage, 8 items: sideboards/consoles/bedside-table - primary product type is furniture per storage.md Section 21/17, not organizational storage); 'Small Shelving' (/collections/small-shelving, 15 items: mostly wall shelves/hangers/pegboard - Furniture/Wall Decor boundary, storage.md Section 18); 'Shelves'/'Shelving' (/collections/shelves, 9 items: freestanding pine/native shelf units - furniture bookshelf boundary); 'Entryway Accessories' (/collections/entryway, 18 items: predominantly hooks/hangers/key-holder, only 2 of 18 are genuine storage - not primary Storage classification); 'Bathroom Accessories' (/collections/bathroom-accessories, 23 items: predominantly towel hangers/hooks/mirrors, only 2 of 23 laundry-related - excluded as bathroom hardware/accessories, not Storage); 'Living Accessories' (/collections/living-accessories-1, 28 items: generic mixed decor catch-all - vases/photo frames/lamps plus some duplicate storage boxes already captured under the main Storage collection - excluded as non-distinct); 'Hook' (/collections/hook - hardware, not Storage or Textile); 'Bookends & Magazine Holders' (/collections/bookends-magazine-holders - decorative, not organizational Storage). No Furniture, Lighting, Kitchen & Dining, Wall Decor, Decorative Accessories, or Bathroom-fixture nodes were misclassified into either array. No duplicate URLs recorded (the two 'Fabric Accents' nav entries under Living and Dining both point to the same /collections/textile URL - recorded once).
